name: minimind
description: 🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours.
one_liner: A step-by-step kit that lets anyone train a small, real, working AI language model from scratch on an ordinary computer in about two hours, purely to learn how it works.
buyer: A university instructor or coding bootcamp running a 'how LLMs actually work' course who needs a hands-on lab students can run on a laptop.
business_use_cases: A university or online bootcamp builds a paid 'train your own LLM' workshop or course module around it.
A corporate AI-literacy trainer uses it as the capstone exercise in an internal 'understand AI' workshop for non-ML engineers.
An educator records a paid course series walking learners through building the model step by step.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a structured paid cohort course that walks learners through the repo with added exercises and support.
License a polished, supported version to corporate L&D teams for internal AI-literacy programs.

steal_this: Record yourself running the repo end-to-end this weekend, bundle it with slides, and sell it as a $49 'build your first LLM' mini-course.
